subject: MAP: Close plan and pricing alignment for Q1 POC
messages:
From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: initial close plan + budget constraints

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for last week's demo. The leadership at Acme Health is enthusiastic about the Redwood inference performance, but procurement has a tight Q1 budget and will need a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and cost runway to move to a signed POC. I've attached our internal budget note and a draft MAP (draft_MAP_v1.pdf).

Key constraints:
- Budget for POC capped at $120k for first 6 months.
- Procurement needs a clear committed spend threshold to release funds (contracting team).
- Security review is on a 3-week cadence; we need any contract redlines early.

Can we schedule a weekly checkpoint next week to align on discount asks, commit sizing, and approval owners? Proposed times: Wed 12/2 or Thu 12/3.

Best,
Anna Lee
Director, Clinical Platforms
Acme Health

Attachments: draft_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft, 6 pages); budget_note_acme.xlsx (referenced)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kar-thik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 17:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: initial close plan + budget constraints

Anna — thanks for the context and the draft MAP. Wed 12/2 10am PT works for me; I'll lock that.

High-level thoughts before the call so we make the checkpoint productive:
- We can support a POC within the $120k spend if Acme can commit to a minimum monthly commit (we usually structure the first 6 months with a commit + variable overage).
- Discount/credits: I can propose a structured credit that scales with commit size. Ballpark we can consider a 15-25% effective discount/credit on tokens for the first 3 months with a modest commit. I'll loop in Kar-thik and Neha to confirm internal approval path and exact thresholds.
- Doc timeline: if procurement can give initial redline targets by 12/10 we can fast-follow legal.

Agenda for Wed's weekly MAP checkpoint:
1) Confirm commit sizing and initial discount framework
2) Identify procurement and security owners + their decision dates
3) Agree on Docusign timeline and next steps for legal
4) Action items and owners (who is driving what week-over-week)

I'll attach a proposed discount schedule after sync with pricing team.

See you Wed.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference

From: procurement@acmehealth.com <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Anna Lee <anna.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: initial close plan + budget constraints

Vivek / Anna — thanks. A few clarifications from procurement side before the call:
- The $120k cap is firm as an approved PO ceiling for Q1; we can structure the spend monthly but the total cannot exceed $120k without additional approvals.
- Preferred procurement contract language: a 90-day exit clause for POC with limited liability and SOC 2 attestation requirement.
- Approval path: procurement (Carlos) -> Legal (Sarah J.) -> CFO (final sign). Estimated internal review ~2 weeks if redlines are minimal.

We'll be on the Wed 10am PT call.

Procurement Team
Acme Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Kar-thik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Acme MAP — discount request and approval ask (prep for 10am call)

Kar-thik / Neha — quick internal note ahead of the 10am PT checkpoint with Acme:

Context: Acme has a firm $120k total POC cap for 6 months. They want a clear commit + discount framework to justify purchase to CFO/procurement. Procurement listed SOC 2 + 90-day exit for POC.

Ask: Can pricing/legal support the following proposal for the call?
- Option A (high-commit): $100k committed over 3 months (monthly installments), 20% token credit applied as a prepaid credit across month 1-3.
- Option B (lower-commit): $60k committed over 3 months, 12% credit + 10k free inference credits for integration costs.

I attached a quick proposed_discount_schedule.xlsx with the math. Need your feedback on whether Option A is approvable without pricing committee and whether we should reserve an exec sponsor credit for exceptions.

Actions:
- Kar-thik: can you confirm approvability (fast lane vs pricing committee) and suggest an internal owner to expedite?
- Neha: please prepare a skeleton of contract language for the 90-day POC exit clause and SOC 2 attestation; we should be ready to email legal immediately after the call.

Thanks — I will surface firm dates from procurement on the call.

—Vivek

From: Kar-thik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme MAP — discount request and approval ask (prep for 10am call)

Vivek — quick routing note after a read of the spreadsheet:
- Option A (20% on $100k commitment) is borderline but can be approved through the fast lane if we get written confirmation of the commit (PO or signed SOW) and an executive sponsor on the Acme side. Fast lane conditions: commit >= $100k, signed SOW, 6-month engagement minimum.
- Option B should be approvable without pricing committee but we should avoid token-based credits phrased as ‘free’ — prefer ‘integration credit’ applied to invoice.
- We should include an SLA appendix limiting liability and a security attestation paragraph; legal to vet.

Owners: Kar-thik (pricing approval fast lane), Neha (contract skeleton / legal handoff), Vivek (exec sponsor + procurement follow-up).

Next step: I will flag this to Sarah in legal with a request to prioritize (aim: 48-hour turnaround on skeleton if procurement provides redlines).

Kar-thik
Senior Manager, Commercial Pricing
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kar-thik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: MAP v2 + next steps (weekly checkpoint summary)

Anna / Carlos — thank you for the productive checkpoint this week. Attached is MAP-v2.pdf that folds in the commit/discount options we discussed and the high-level timeline. Summary and agreed action items below.

Summary
- Agreed options:
  * Option A: $100k committed over first 3 months — 20% credit applied as prepaid invoice credit (fast-lane approval required).
  * Option B: $60k committed over first 3 months — 12% credit + 10k integration credit.
- Acme procurement: $120k PO cap is understood. Acme will confirm which option (A or B) by COB 12/10 to keep legal on a 2-week review track.
- Security: Acme requires SOC 2 attestation; Redwood will provide latest report and security appendix.

Action items (owners and target dates)
- Acme (Anna/Carlos): confirm preferred option and provide procurement PO or internal approval note — due 2026-12-10.
- Vivek: circulate final discount schedule and HubSpot deal update — due 2026-12-06.
- Kar-thik: confirm fast-lane approval for Option A or route to pricing committee if conditions not met — due 2026-12-07.
- Neha: draft contract skeleton with 90-day POC exit clause and SOC 2 attestation language for legal handoff — due 2026-12-08.
- Legal (Sarah J.): review redlines and SLA appendix once received — target turnaround 48 hours after receipt.

Next meeting: weekly MAP checkpoint — Thu 12/9 9:00am PT (tentative).

Links/attachments: MAP-v2.pdf (attached), HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/ACME-98765, DocuSign pre-fill: https://www.docusign.com/link/ABC-123-ACME

If we get the PO by 12/10 we should be able to start provisioning dedicated capacity in late Dec and kick off the security onboarding early Jan.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v2.pdf; proposed_discount_schedule.xlsx
